title: Mauritius Couple Escape
headline: One lagoon stay, unhurried, just the two of you.
description: Six nights in Mauritius: a single resort on the west or north coast, with one island or mountain day if you want it.
image_alt: Clear lagoon water over a coral reef
price_label: Quoted for your resort and dates
price_guidance: Mauritius pricing depends on resort, meal plan and whether you add Île aux Cerfs or Le Morne. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s island week with one check-in. We shortlist west- or north-coast resorts for lagoon, privacy and dining, then coordinate the airport run and any catamaran or Chamarel day you want.
highlights: Six nights in one resort — no hotel-hopping.
Meal plan chosen with you before booking.

exclusions: Spa, paid water sports and extra boat days unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
